title: Estrangement Between Banda Singh And Tat Khalsa

blocks.text: Banda claims that kingdom, land, and prestige flowed through him to the Singhs, while the Khalsa reads those boasts as evidence that he is nearing destruction.
Open tension now grows into hostility, and the Khalsa withdraws rather than validating his inflation of self.
The page is anchored in the idea of turning from the Guru’s power toward self-claimed power, which in the narrative signals collapse.
